actions.description: The action buttons to show to the right.

collapseThreshold.description:
The maximum number of actions that should be rendered as distinct, standalone buttons. If more than
{@link collapseThreshold} actions are provided, then each action after `collapseThreshold - 1` will be rendered
together in a dropdown menu behind an ellipsis button.

title: Action group shown to the right of {@link UiSdlPageTitle}.
name: UiSdlPageTitleActionGroup
